properties.name: OBSERVED (branch at b639be8 + phase 2, in-memory): add_decision with status "rejected" and an approver writes the Decision `proposed`, with no refusal and no note; only the loop hint says "a Decision lands proposed"
properties.statement:
OBSERVED 2026-10-18 while writing phase 2's tests (reflow2 at b639be8 plus feat/reasoning-attached-to-the-structure-it-justifies, in-memory service through MCP). A Contributor who:owner was added, then add_decision {id, name, decision, rationale, status: "rejected", approver: "who:owner"}. The reply stored properties.status "proposed", is_error false, and said only loop_hint "loop: a Decision lands `proposed` — only the owner's word moves it (set_decision_status)". The same call without an approver is refused naming the rule. Expected: either the Decision lands rejected and signed (the one-call settle path accepted for `accepted`), or the call is refused saying which statuses it settles. Workaround used: add_decision, then set_decision_status {status: "rejected", approver, chose}. No cause is stated here: not yet walked with the root-cause skill. Precedent read first (search_design): fact:root-cause-add-decisions-lands-proposed-hint-recurred-on-the-one-call-settle-path-2026-09-29, a different symptom (the hint is wrong on a write that DID settle). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq

MEASURED AGAIN 2026-10-19 on the PUBLISHED 0.87.0 binary (one scratch design per case, --call; no cause stated):
- add_decision with an approver stores `accepted` → accepted and `deferred` → deferred.
- `rejected` → PROPOSED and `superseded` → PROPOSED, with the AUTHORED_BY role=approver edge drawn all the same. So a proposed Decision carries the owner's approver signature, and the reply's loop hint says "a Decision lands `proposed`".
- set_decision_status rejected → rejected (correct).
- add_requirement accepted/deferred/dropped/met all store as given (correct).
The defect is confined to add_decision's two retiring statuses. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq

CLOSED 2026-10-19 by PR #773 (branch fix/statuses-and-redraws-keep-what-was-given, commit 225b20d), chg:statuses-and-redraws-keep-what-was-given-2026-10-19. Cause: fact:root-cause-a-constructor-wrote-its-status-only-when-the-call-settled-and-signed-whatever-it-wrote-2026-10-19. One correction to the first paragraph: on main 6a45d4b the same call WITHOUT an approver was not refused; it also stored `proposed`, silently. The class test found two more instances (a revise back to `proposed` ignored on Decision and Requirement; an approver drawn on a `proposed` node). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
